summary: You act on instinct and it tends to work. Drive and originality flow together, so you move fast, improvise well, and take bold chances without much fear. Decisiveness comes naturally.
body: You act on instinct and it tends to work. Drive and originality flow together, so you move fast, improvise well, and take bold chances without much fear. Decisiveness comes naturally. You're quick on your feet, good in a sudden change, the one who acts while others are still deciding. Because it's easy, the risk is mistaking fast for finished, or chasing the thrill of the new and never seeing anything through. The work is following the bold start all the way to the end.
gift: At your best: decisive, original, quick and effective under change.
shadow: The trap: mistaking fast for finished, chasing the new and never finishing.
integration: Let drive and anger and freedom and disruption cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Innovative and fast; the cost is recklessness and volatility.
do: Follow the bold start to the end
Use the quickness on something lasting
dont: Chase the thrill of the new
